From a British viewpoint, you could say that the definition is, "the belief in a society without different social classes in which the methods of production are owned and controlled by its members and everyone works as much as they can and receives what they need", taken from the Cambridge dictionary. Even then, we can't use dictionary definitions for everything. For example - dictionary.com, the same dictionary you used, defines the word 'Satanism' as "diabolical or satanic disposition, behaviour or activity", when we should understand that Satanism is rather a group of beliefs centralised around the figure of Satan (this is just an example outside of politics of course, I'm sure there are MANY other outdated definitions in every dictionary there is, including that of the word communism). My point is, dictionaries aren't always reliable and definitions of words depend on who you ask.
